I'm not a physicist, but the odds are not good. A photon has zero mass, so I doubt it's capable of moving air to make sound waves. Sorry to disappoint you, here's something you may be interested in though.
it has zero mass but it has momentum, and is quite capable of moving air by heating it up as a result, though this won't make noise under any ordinary circumstance.

But isn't heat is a measure of the average rate of collisions between particles for a given substance? In order for light to increase that rate it would have to collide with them and give them more energy wouldn't it?

its the average kinetic energy of particles.

Sound isn't heat energy though. The energy of heat is totally disordered. the molecules are moving in every direction at once, spinning, wobbling, vibrating. Sound is ordered kinetic energy, you need to make all the molecules in one spot have a higher energy in the same direction than the surrounding molecules. That's why wind is noisy but a hot summer day isn't.

I suspect this conversation in some way involves Synesthesia, where people interpret senses in an intermingled way (IE hearing light or seeing sound), I don't know anything more than that about it so here's a wikipedia link: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synesthesia

I want to propose a 3 step approach to this problem. This may not be perfect, so please chip in and suggest improvements/corrections.

  1. Mod tools: Allow moderators to write notes to other moderators for each user within a subverse. So if I am a mod, I can post a note saying "User violated rule 4 on 7/16/2015. Warned that next violation will result in ban from subverse"

  2. Public moderation logs. If I can't see a subverse's mod logs, I won't trust that subverse with the power to ban me.

  3. "Promotion mode". If you are attempting to promote your site, product or opinion, for which you are receiving money, traffic or reputation as a "new media expert", you should tag your post/comment as a promoted material. Violators can be warned and banned by mods of subverses and voaters get a filter to "hide all promoted material".

Key is to let mods do the banning, give mods tools to track bad behavior of a user over time and build in an "ad block" deep into the core of voat so that it can never sell its soul and monetize the reddit way.
